headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2023, the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Big Bill went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.74. This stood as the 20th match in AEW International Title history ? a notable milestone for the title. Moxley overcame interference from Ricky Starks to lock Big Bill in a standing triangle choke in his hometown of Cincinnati, retaining the International Title.
On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Samoa Joe vs. Roderick Strong met in a Tournament Final, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.21 ? a good, competitive contest.
